title: Change Control and Rescheduling Tariff for Professional Services Projects
content:
The change control tariff of Professional Services Projects lists, for each engagement class, the change order administration fee, the value change below which no fee is charged, the most the contract value may grow through change orders, how long a change order stays open for signature, and the notice and fee that apply when the client moves the scheduled start.

| Figure | Assessment Engagement | Quick Start Project | Standard Project | Advanced Project | Major Project | Strategic Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Administration fee per signed scope or schedule change order (USD) | 0.00 | 95.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 350.00 | 500.00 |
| Absolute value change below which no change order fee is charged (USD) | 0.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 | 10000.00 |
| Most the contract value may grow through change orders, as a percent of the original value, before a new statement of work is required | 25 | 25 | 30 | 35 | 40 | 50 |
| Calendar days a change order stays open for signature before it lapses | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 |
| Business days of notice before the scheduled start at or beyond which the client may reschedule without a fee | 3 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 15 | 20 |
| Fee for a client reschedule with less notice than that (USD) | 150.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 |

## Reading the tariff

- The fee waiver row is a threshold on the absolute value change, so an increase and a reduction of the same size stand in the same position against it.
- The growth limit is measured against the original value of the statement of work, not against the contract value as earlier change orders have moved it.
- Hypothetical illustration: on an Advanced Project whose original value is 80000.00, a growth limit of 35 percent means change orders may take the contract value up to 108000.00 and no higher; a reschedule requested with 10 business days of notice or more carries no fee, and one with 9 business days carries the reschedule fee of 1000.00.
